Header: Gynaikothrips karny Sinhala – Pala makka; Tamil - Milaku pani poochchi

Prevention: Select healthy and insect-free planting material for propagation in nurseries
Remove all weeds in nursery beds.
Monitoring: Look for the following damage symptoms, particularly in the nursery:
Formation of small and deformed leaves.
Stunting, wilting and death of nursery plants at severe infestation levels
Direct Control: Keep damaged plants separately in the nursery
Remove and burn heavily infested leaves and branches
If severely damaged, burn the whole plant
Rate of dilution - 2.5g / 10 lit. of water
Rate of dilution - 3g / 10 lit. of water
Restrictions: Always wear personal protective equipment while handling pesticides.
Read manufacturer’s instructions carefully before handling pesticides.
Do not eat, drink or smoke while spraying pesticides
U – Unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use
Toxic to predatory mites, ladybird beetles, earthworms and fish and moderately toxic to parasitoids.
Do not apply at the flowering stage of mature trees.
